input.quote: B. User Manuals. The reports made available to Customer shall be in substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and the User Manuals, as amended from time to time, copies of which have been, or will be, provided to Customer.
input.rationale: § 16.1 does give express M&I warranties — systems capable of performing the Services (A), reports in substantial conformity with the User Manuals and customer bulletins (B), rights (C), authority (D) and Millennium Compliance (E) — and the § 16.1(F) disclaimer is expressly carved back ("EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1"), so this is not an AS-IS walk-away. Two fallback elements nonetheless fail on material terms. First, no warranty period is stated anywhere in operative language, so neither the 90-day software floor nor the 30-day services floor is confirmable on the face of the Agreement. Second, there is no warranty remedy: § 12.3 offers only dispute resolution or termination plus Damages, § 13.4 caps that recovery at three months' fees, and the § 9.2(D) service level credits are redacted. We therefore insert one lettered subsection § 16.1(G) that fixes an express minimum period at the fallback floors (ninety (90) days for reports, thirty (30) days for Services) while preserving the existing Term-long coverage, and supplies repair or replacement or, at Customer's election, a refund of the fees paid. Preferred extras (professional and workmanlike standard, compliance with laws, no malicious code, 12-month software period) and § 9.1's "no other or higher degree of care" language are noted but not pressed at this target level.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The § 16.1 warranties state no period and carry no remedy, so we add one lettered subsection that fixes an express minimum warranty period (ninety (90) days for reports and thirty (30) days for Services, without cutting back the existing Term-long coverage) and gives repair or replacement or, at our election, a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or reports. This is our fallback position.

ops.text: Warranty Period; Remedy. The warranties in Sections 16.1(A) and (B) shall remain in effect throughout the Term and in any event for not less than ninety (90) days following delivery of each report and thirty (30) days following performance of each Service. For breach of any warranty in this Section 16.1, M&I shall promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Services or reports or, at Customer's election, refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or reports.
